schema.title: F5 XC Service Policy Configuration
schema.description: JSON Schema for F5 Distributed Cloud service_policy resource with UI tooltips, defaults, and nested configurations

name.description:
The configuration object will be created with name. It has to be unique within the namespace.
The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
name.x-f5xc-pattern-description: Must start with lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and end with letter or number

labels.description:
Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize
(scope and select) objects as chosen by the user.

description.description: Human readable description for the object.

server_selection.description:
Select which servers this policy applies to.
Any Server matches all servers, or specify specific servers by name or pattern.

x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Any Server: Apply policy to any server (default behavior).
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Server Name: Apply policy to a specific server by name.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Group of Servers by Name: Apply policy to servers matching exact values or regex patterns.

select_policy_rules.description:
Choose the type of policy rules to apply.
Custom Rule List allows detailed rule configuration, or use predefined allow/deny behaviors.

x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Custom Rule List: Configure a custom list of policy rules with detailed matching and action configurations.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Allowed Sources: Allow requests from specified source IP prefixes.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Denied Sources: Deny requests from specified source IP prefixes.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Allow All Requests: Allow all requests without any restrictions.

server_name_config.description: Specify a single server name to apply the policy to.

server_name.description: Name of the specific server this policy applies to.

server_group_config.description: Specify server names using exact values and/or regex patterns.

server_exact_values.description: List of exact server names to match.

server_regex_values.description: List of regex patterns to match server names.

allowed_sources_config.description: Allow requests from specified source IP prefixes.

allowed_source_prefixes.description: IP prefixes (CIDR notation) from which requests are allowed.

denied_sources_config.description: Deny requests from specified source IP prefixes.

denied_source_prefixes.description: IP prefixes (CIDR notation) from which requests are denied.

rules.description:
List of custom policy rules. Rules are evaluated in order.
First matching rule determines the action.

name.description:
The configuration object will be created with name. It has to be unique within the namespace.
The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
name.x-f5xc-pattern-description: Must start with lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and end with letter or number

rule_description.description: Human readable description for this rule.

client_selection.description:
Select which clients this rule applies to.
Any Client matches all clients, or specify by name, label, or threat category.
enum: Group of Clients by Label Selector

x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Client Name: The expected name of the client invoking the request API. The predicate evaluates to true if any of the actual names is the same as the expected client name.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Group of Clients by Name: A list of exact values and/or regular expressions for the expected name of the client.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.List of IP Threat Categories: IP threat categories to choose from.
x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Group of Clients by Label Selector: Match clients by Kubernetes-style label selector.

client_name.description: The expected name of the client invoking the request API. The predicate evaluates to true if any of the actual names is the same as the expected client name.

client_name_exact_values.description: List of exact client names to match.

client_name_regex_values.description: List of regex patterns to match client names.

ip_threat_categories.description: IP threat categories to match against client IP addresses.

domain_exact_values.description: List of exact domain names to match.

domain_regex_values.description: List of regex patterns to match domain names.

http_method.description: HTTP method to match. ANY matches all methods.

invert_method_matcher.description: Invert the HTTP method matcher. When enabled, the rule matches all methods except the selected one.

path_match_type.description:
Type of path matching to use.
Prefix matches paths starting with value, Path matches exact path, Regex uses regular expression.

x-f5xc-enum-descriptions.Prefix: Match paths starting with the specified prefix.

path_value.description: Path value to match (prefix, exact, or regex pattern depending on match type).

api_group_matcher.description: API group to match for API discovery integration.

source_segments.description: Source segments to match. Any Segment matches all segments, or specify a custom segment list.

user_identity_exact_values.description: List of exact user identity values to match.

user_identity_regex_values.description: List of regex patterns to match user identities.
